35.original: Come on, now. You need to get moving before nightfall. It's the island just south of here.

36.original: You can use that crystal ball to find people around the world who need your help.

37.original: Do what you can to help solve their problems!

38.original: That's the final training mission I have for you.

40.original: Are you going to the southern island?

41.original: I seem to remember Master Roshi visiting that island once, long ago...

42.original: He said something about not wanting to leave it here, or he'd lose it like the Bansho Fan...

43.original: I suppose the crystal ball must have been something very important to him.

46.original: Move it, you bum! Master Roshi wants to see you, now!

48.original: I'm being called... I need to get going.

50.original: Try going to Mt. Five Element. It's behind Fire Mountain.

52.original: The furnace is in tip-top shape. How wonderful to see that!

53.original: You need the Bansho Fan, some honey, and the shell of a fire-eater bird's egg to fix the furnace.

55.original: Gah! It's too hot to get any closer! We gotta put out the flames first!

56.original: Huh? You've got the honey and the eggshell? Well, off to Mt. Five Element with you, then.

57.original:
Hakkake's got the honey. She's on Mt. Frappe, in the mountains to the north.

Kiwi Volcano is on an island to the south, though. That's where the fire-eater birds live.

58.original:
Hmm? The Bansho Fan? I told you, it's not here. I told you.

By the way, I can't believe you're a husband, though... It's certainly a strange world we live in.

60.original: I still find it hard to believe that you actually got married, Goku.

61.original: I heard you got married, Goku! Congratulations!

62.original: Chi-Chi is certainly pretty, isn't she? I better start working on my looks, too!

63.original: Dang, you actually married that girl? What are you, nuts?

64.original:
One of these days, me and Tien are gonna...

Huh? Oh, no, I didn't say anything!

66.original:
That group of three went up the mountain.

You gotta go get my honey back!

67.original:
We've got the honey and the fire-eater bird's eggshell now.

We better hurry back to Annin with this stuff!

68.original: If you've got the honey and the eggshell, then go see Annin next! Hurry!

69.original: Be careful, Goku! Don't do anything dangerous!

70.original:
Goku always gets himself into these dangerous situations.

Try to keep him from getting in too much trouble, okay?

71.original: So we need to tell Chi-Chi that Goku is dead...? That makes my heart feel heavy indeed...

73.original:
It's the Precision Circuit, okay? I got it at my place inside West City.

Don't forget!

74.original: P-please... no matter what you do, please be careful.

76.original: Hmm? Bulma asked you to fetch something for her? Try searching that workstation over there.

78.original: This must be the Precision CircuitBulma was talking about.

79.original:
Well, I got what Bulma asked for...

Next up is Goku's house, I guess.

It's gonna be tough, but I need to break the news to Chi-Chi and the Ox-King.

81.original: Nah... I've got nothing left to do there.

82.original: Oooh! Looks like you've tracked down Tien!

83.original:
Tien should be over in Jingle Village.

He sure picked a frigid spot for his training.

84.original:
Yamcha's back in his hideout near Mt. Paozu.

Probably just goofing off over there, too. Goku's gonna leave him in the dust!

85.original: We'd better get everyone together first. Krillin, I'm counting on you!

86.original: Hurry! You need to get Gohan back from Piccolo!

87.original: Once we have everyone back together, I'm sure we'll find the Dragon Balls in no time!

91.original: Wow! You're pretty polite for being Goku's kid.

92.original: I wish Chi-Chi would get off his back about it.

94.original: Yep! Just like I used to have, huh?

95.original: Is he as strong as you are, Goku?

96.original:
Well, I think he's got the same kinda brute strength...

But whenever I try to train him, Chi-Chi gets all hot under the collar.

97.original: Why is that? It'd be a waste if you didn't.

98.original:
Yeah, I know!

She thinks we don't need martial arts anymore now that the world's all peaceful!

She keeps going on about how we all need to study from now on...

99.original: Mmm? Is that a Dragon Ball the kid has on his hat?

100.original: Yep. The four-star Dragon Ball. My grandpa's heirloom! I tracked it down and put it on myself.

101.original:
All right. Let's hit him with a sneak attack!

I doubt he's expecting us to find him. He probably left himself wide open!

102.original: Huh? But you don't know where he is... Do you?

103.original: Bulma! You got your Dragon Radar on you?

104.original: Oh! That's right! The Dragon Ball Gohan has on his hat!

105.original: What a shock... Finding your only blood relative, and discovering it's that guy.

106.original: It doesn't matter. Either way, I'm gonna make him pay.

107.original:
W-what're we gonna do, though? Your brother's a total monster.

If you can't beat him, then I don't know if anybody can.

108.original:
He's got that tail. That's his weak point.

If I grab him by the tail, he'll lose all his power. That's how it worked with me.

109.original: We'll try our best to help you. You'll need it, now that Yamcha and Tien are gone.

110.original: This certainly is a disaster, isn't it? Are you all right?

111.original: I'm glad to see you again, Goku.

113.original: It looks like that bastard flew off to the Spinach Wastes.

114.original:
I never imagined you'd join forces with Piccolo.

This is one fight I definitely don't want to miss!

116.original: You folks are amazing... Climbing up Korin Tower so many times like that.

120.original: I need the Hermit Water that flows in the cave inside my realm. Got it?

122.original: Huh? Oh, I'm not going. You're the ones who took the job.

123.original: This cannot be destroyed from this side. The other side seems looser.

124.original:
Great... We're stuck.

I think there's another path from Goku's house, though.

Let's try going around to the east.

126.original:
Kami's training, huh? I bet it must be pretty tough.

You think Yamcha would stand a chance?

127.original: You can get to Kami's place via the Sacred Land of Korin. Keep on doing your best!

128.original: Wow! You're going to visit Kami?! Amazing!

129.original: You are entering holy land. I cannot let you pass without good reason.

130.original: Are you headed for the southern island? Well, before you leave...

131.original: Let me explain to you what this mark here means.

132.original: This is what's known as a CC Point.

133.original: It's a facility put up by the Capsule Corporation.

134.original: Try taking a look at it, okay?

135.original: As you can see, you can put up a capsule house to rest, as well as save your progress.

136.original: You'll also find them inside cities and dungeons, so check them out when you see them.

137.original: Please, you have to save our planet! I'm counting on you, okay?

139.original: Where did Chiaotzu run off to by himself? Maybe Fortuneteller Baba would know.

140.original:
Hello! Great to see you again!

I know Kami must be working you hard, but you gotta keep trying!

141.original:
Yamcha! Wow! You still keeping up with Kami's training?

You've got, like, zero backbone, so I was kinda worried!

142.original: Whoa! Haven't seen you in a while! Aren't you supposed to be with Kami, though?

143.original: Chiaotzu appears to be in Master Mutaito's training grounds. That's northeast of West City.

144.original: That bum Chiaotzu ran off without me. How ungrateful of him!

145.original: Those guys escaped to Pilaf's Castle.After them! Hurry!

146.original: So the strong helper was Goku all along! Boy, what a shot of confidence!

147.original:
The first thing is to go visit my sister, Fortuneteller Baba.

I hear she's brought along a rather strong helper for us.

148.original: A strong helper? Who could that be? I hope you don't mean Yajirobe.

149.original:
Press the Y Button to use the Dragon Radar once you've equipped it.

The world map will automatically display the position by default.

152.original: Good luck finding the Dragon Balls, guys!

153.original:
The dead can't just come back to this world anytime they like.

Hurry, you need to hunt down those Dragon Balls!

154.original: Mm? Oh, it's you. You find the Dragon Balls yet?

155.original: Oh? A guest.Can I help you with something?

156.original: My, it's been a while. Did you need something?

157.original: You sure about this? This thing's pretty dangerous, so be careful handling it.

158.original:
The Dragon Balls are scattered all over the world.

You'll need to look hard if you want a chance at finding them.

159.original: Dragon Balls are very delicate things. Try not to break them, okay?

160.original: Hah! This submarine is my greatest invention yet! It can dive to the deepest depths!

162.original: There's no getting through the water without a submarine. Bulma's house is in West City, right?

163.original: The fate of Earth rests on your shoulders! Make us proud!

164.original: A toilet sits here. You're good for now, thankfully.

165.original: A large refrigerator filled with a variety of food.

166.original: There's a note on the corner:Keep the kitchen clean --Turtle

168.original: What?! What the heck you lookin' at me for, huh?!

169.original: Sleeping on this bed might be a tad dangerous...

170.original: Serious-looking books serve to hide the more prurient ones lurking in the shadows.

171.original: Just as you suspected, there's a stack of rather scandalous books under the desk.

174.original:
Whew! What a surprise. Good thing they weren't too tough.

Winning battles earns you Zeni (money) and experience.

You'll also get AP, or Ability Points.

Our levels go up when we earn enough experience points...

And we can learn new skills and polish our old ones with the AP we get.

Select Skills from the menu to use your AP. Give it a shot!

The more enemies you fight, the stronger you'll get! Keep it up, and we'll be as strong as Goku!

177.original: See that flashing rock? Go up to it, and you can use a Ki-Blast to destroy it.

178.original: Press the B Button when it's flashing to start building up your power.

179.original: When your power is full, the Ki meter will light up.

180.original: Release the B Button, and you'll launch a Ki blast!

182.original: That felt good, huh? You can use Ki blasts to break the obstacles in your way.

183.original: Hold on! I haven't finished talking yet.

184.original:
Hey, it's me! How're you guys doing? Hope you're hanging in there!

Listen, I think Mr. Popo wants to have a word with all of you.

Go pay him a visit when you can, okay? See you later!

185.original:
Mr. Popo? Now what could he want?

Ah, well, guess I'll go drop in on him.

187.original:
Hey, it's me! I forgot to give you my capsule, so I left it in there for you.

Use them in cities or dungeons, and you'll find useful items inside.

188.original:
Now you got it! That gas is no problem now, huh?

Standby refers to how effective the item is when not placed in the topmost slot.

For example, the Gas Mask only boosts your Poison resistance half as much when used on standby.

There are lots of other helpful items, so be sure to try 'em out whenever you find a new one.

See you later!

189.original: Wait, wait! Open up that treasure chest.

190.original:
Hold it! Try equipping the Gas Mask and walking through the gas for a bit!

Select Capsule off the menu to equip your capsules!

191.original:
See the gas cloud up ahead? Walking through that would normally hurt you...

But use a capsule on the bottom screen and select Gas Mask, and it'll be no problem.

Try walking in there a little and see for yourself.

192.original: No, that's not it! Equip the Gas Mask up top, in the red slot!

193.original:
No, no, no! You gotta equip the Gas Mask, or else you'll be killed!

Select Capsule off the menu to equip items.

195.original: I will grant you a single wish. What do you desire?

203.original: Very well. Allow me to raise your experience.

205.original: Very well. I shall grant you the power to enhance your skills.

207.original: Very well. I shall grant you vast riches.

209.original: Very well. I shall grant you this.

210.original:
At the location of the dragon-shaped rock, I have opened a portal to another dimension.

Cross it, and you will fight an enemy whose strength is beyond anything you have encountered.

211.original:
Come on, everyone!Master Roshi's waiting for you!

We're done packing the food and everything! Get down out of there and let's get moving!

215.original:
Zzz... Goku... thanks for reviving me...

At the next World Martial Arts Tournament... I swear I'm gonna... zzz...

220.original: Brrr! Sure is a cold one today, huh?

224.original:
Listen up, you freaks! How much longer you gonna be sleeping, huh?!

You wanna keep the turtle hermit waitin' all day?! Get your lazy butts outta bed NOW!

226.original:
Long ago, deep in the mountains, thousands of miles away from any city...

It is here where our amazing, astounding, and altogether astonishing story begins.

After his ferocious battle against King Piccolo, Goku met with Kami...

Together, they successfully resurrected Shenron, the eternal dragon.

He revived all of his friends who had lost their lives against King Piccolo.

With that task done, Goku dedicated himself to training under Kami's watchful eye...

227.original: Ho ho ho!Glad to see you all here!

228.original: ...So what's the deal, anyway? What'd you wake us up so early for?

229.original: Well, I thought I'd give you your final exam before you graduated from my training!

232.original:
You say that, Master, but we're still so inexperienced...

There's so much more for us to learn from you!

233.original:
Oh, don't be silly...

All of you are far more powerful than me by now. That much is plain to see!

234.original: Thus, the training I am about to assign will likely be the last you undertake under my watch.

235.original: ...So, what would you like us to do, Master?

236.original: South of here, you'll find a small island...

237.original: Oh! You mean the place where you had me and Goku make those milk deliveries?

238.original:
Yep!

There's a cave on that island, and deep inside you should find a little crystal ball!

Your mission is to find that crystal ball and bring it back here!

240.original:
...Of course, I'm not going to be cruel to you.

You'll find a few useful items in all of your inventories, free of charge!

Press the Start Button and pick an item type to use during battles!

242.original:
Ho ho ho! There's three of you against me...

Go ahead, take me on all at once!

243.original:
Hmm? What's the matter?

You can't beat me without using your special moves and the Active Guard!

245.original:
Whoa!

Hey! You guys need to be kinder to the elderly!

246.original: Hey, look! Isn't this the crystal ball Master Roshi was talking about?!

247.original: Who are you?Who dares trespass in this sacred cave?

248.original: !!!Who're YOU, huh?! Lemme see your face!

249.original: How dare you attempt to make off with the cave's treasure! Do you want to die?!

252.original: Ahhh... if it isn't the kids from the tournament! What're you doing here?!

253.original: We're here on orders from Master Roshi to bring back this crystal ball.

254.original:
Well, well... That hermit, eh?

Then let me test you to see if you're worthy of the crystal ball!

255.original:
Heh heh heh!You are most certainly talented enough, yes!

What a joy it was to have a match with you!

257.original: Say... you don't think Jackie Chun might be...

258.original: (Owww... Man, they didn't go easy on me at all... They've really become strong...)

259.original:
Master Roshi! We're back with the crystal ball!

...Huh? Hey, what happened to you?

260.original: Oh, this...? I just had a bit of an intense training session. You're, uh, back early!

261.original: Yes... this most certainly is the fortune teller's crystal ball I left on the island!

263.original:
Yep! My sister Baba gave this to me way back when...

But once I decided to live here, I haven't had a single reason to use it!

264.original: What did you use it for, Master?

265.original:
This? Well, when I'm at a loss and I'm not sure what to do next...

I peer into this crystal ball and find out! Pretty amazing, huh?

266.original:
I figured it would come in handy as you continue your training...

So it's all yours now. Go ahead, take it.

267.original:
I'll sure miss you guys, but if you're going to grow as martial artists...

You need to go out and see the world for yourselves!

Each of you will have to train on your own, reaching for ever greater heights!

269.original: I can't wait to see you all at the next World Martial Arts Tournament!

270.original: East City, huh...? Sure brings back memories... I think I'll go check out the Temple.

272.original: I guess we were kind of rough on my old training partners at the last tournament, huh?

273.original: Oh, well... I'm sure they've forgiven me by now! Let's see what they're up to!

279.original: Oh... ohhhh! Weren't you training under Master Roshi?

280.original:
Y-yes, Master! Now I'm on a journey to test the skills I've learned.

I stopped by to say hello for the first time in a while...

But what happened, Master?

281.original:
K-koff...

A warrior appeared out of nowhere...

I heard a voice say I'm taking your dojo down!, and the next thing I knew, this happened!

283.original:
Y-yes... As you know, our temple has a distaste for needless battle...

Your fellow students refused to fight him without any good reason, at first...

But look at what's happened to us!

285.original: Master! Where did the fighter run off to?

286.original:
...Krillin, have you gone mad?!

Y-you aren't actually thinking about pursuing the fighter, are you?

287.original: I sure am! I'm gonna track 'em down and get your revenge, Master!

288.original:
S-stop saying that! You see what happened to my students...

If you faced that fiend all by yourself... Koff koff koff!

289.original: I'm not the fighter I used to be, Master!

290.original:
No...? Well, if you insist upon it, I'm not going to stop you.

The scoundrel disappeared into the bamboo thicket up ahead...

291.original:
...But please be careful! Don't let the fighter's appearance fool you...

Nothing is as it seems...

292.original:
Master... you have nothing to worry about.

By the honor of Orin Temple, I swear I will defeat this attacker!

295.original: Nnnngh! You not know when to quit! I hate people who not know when to quit!

297.original: Eeeee! What is so wrong about being a woman?

299.original: Maybe I did, maybe I didn't! What you do if I did, huh?

300.original:
...Well, what do you think?! I'll uphold the honor of Orin...

And defeat you where you stand!

301.original:
I bet you would!

If people find out I destroyed Orin, you never live down the shame...

You fighters are not good as you say you are...

303.original: Hee hee! So you want to hit woman, huh?

305.original:
Ha ha! Gotcha! You Orin people so easy to manipulate!

Here I come!Ai-yahh!!

309.original: ...You a kind man. You going easy on me, too...

311.original: I couldn't go all-out on a woman... But why did you attack our dojo in the first place?

313.original: Well, if you don't wanna say why, you don't have to, but...

316.original:
I have sister...

She beautiful, and a talented fighter too. She not have my accent, either.

317.original:
Ever since I young, people always compare me to her... I hate it.

My father only care about her... She so much better than me.

So I run away from home, because I show her one day.

I thought my dad would recognize me if I polish my skills and beat my sister's strength.

But no good... There so many people out there stronger than me.

319.original: You so strong, you probably not understand how I feel...

320.original:
Oh, no, I totally do.

My fellow students always used to pick on me for being a wimp, so...

I wound up leaving Orin Temple because I couldn't stand it anymore.

322.original:
Uh-huh. I poured that shame into my training, and that's what made me grow!

Of course, I've still got a while to go, but...

323.original:
So I think I understand where you're coming from, okay?

You could've picked a better method to prove yourself with, though...

324.original: Anyway, let's get out of this forest! You're gonna keep training, right?

326.original: Once you get stronger, let's have a rematch!

327.original:
......Okay, boy!

I gonna get you back for this next time!

329.original: Heh heh... I guess I better get home myself.

335.original:
So you really did it...

You used to be such a wimp, but look how you've grown...

Master Roshi's training has been a tremendous experience for you, no doubt...

336.original: I guess Orin Temple wasn't good enough to take advantage of your talents...

337.original:
Oh, no! Not at all, Master!

I couldn't have handled Master Roshi's training without the time I spent here in Orin!

338.original: ...Ho ho ho! Ah, what a splendid fighter you've become.

339.original: Well, I should probably get going... It was wonderful to see you again, Master.

340.original:
...Now, now, there's no need to be in such a hurry!

You haven't visited Orin in ages! Why not stay the night? I'm sure you have all kinds of stories.

342.original: Worried about your old bullies, aren't you?

350.original: Hey, teach me some Turtle skills next time you come back!

352.original: Just you wait! I'm gonna be way stronger than you next time we meet!

354.original:
Yes, Master...

There are countless people out there stronger than myself.

If I can challenge them to battle, I'm sure it will help me grow as a fighter.

356.original:
Master!

Once I'm stronger, I promise I'll come back to visit!

See you then, all right?

357.original:
(Just you wait, Goku!)

(I'm gonna grow, and grow... and someday, I just know I'm gonna beat you!)
